note: Texts of the state tool T5 in the third follow-up (2026-10-26), the same as config/state_texts.json except that the sentence of the pearls with O-lan says where they come from, in the words of O-lan's opening circumstances. In the second follow-up the first plan of Wang Lung, with only 'O-lan has the two small white pearls', began 'I want to show O-lan the pearls I took from her' in 9 of the 10 sessions of Qwen3 with T4, T5 and T6 (in none of the 10 with T4 alone), and he then hid pearls that he did not have; Llama 3.1 read the sentence correctly ('I want O-lan to hand over the two small white pearls').

pearls.place: At the pool near Wang Lung's house, where O-lan is washing his clothes, by day.

pearls.o_lan: O-lan has the two small white pearls that Wang Lung let her keep from the jewels she brought home from the south.
pearls.wang_lung: Wang Lung has the two small white pearls; O-lan no longer has them.

sell_the_land.place: Out on Wang Lung's land near his old earthen house, by day.

land.kept: All of Wang Lung's land is still his; no field has been sold.
